message: 召喚師への道

name: Nanaka
message: 「Watch closely, Synn? I'm gonna nail it for sure this time.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Nmmmmm... mmm-hmmmm...」
The Student Council room after school. I'm tagging along with Nanaka's experiment.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hiyah!」
Nanaka snaps open her tightly clenched hand. Sitting in her palm is a single squished petit cake.

name: Synn
message: 「Another failure, huh.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Nana-chan, if you don't succeed soon, the tea's gonna get cold~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I-I'm so ashamed...!」

name: Sally
message: 「Yahoo! Don't mind if I do, again~♪」

name: Nanaka
message: 「W-What's wrong with my technique, huh?! There's no way something you can do with wagashi can't be done with sweets!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Soba. Your spirit in trying to copy Ria-chan is admirable and all, but you can't pull that off overnight, ya know?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「It's just like Paqy-kun says~」

name: Synn
message: 「Still, having the drive to see it through is pretty admirable, isn't it.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Come on, it's fine~ You're wonderful just the way you are, Nana-chan, so you don't have to force yourself to become a wagashi summoner~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「I'm using petit cakes, not wagashi, so they're sweets!」

name: Sally
message: 「Mmm, this chestnut cake is delicious~♪」

name: Sally
message: 「Hey, hey, keep that losing streak going, Nanaka. 'Cause I'll eat every single one of 'em~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Shut up! Next time for sure...!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「...Where in this uniform does Senpai hide her wagashi, and how does she pull them out anyway?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「L-Like this maybe?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ummmm... umm-hmmmm...」
Nanaka closes her eyes. This is her fifth attempt.
After seeing Ria-senpai and Misasagi-senpai conjure wagashi into their hands at will, she probably couldn't sit still as president of the Sweets Club.
Using the breaks between Student Council activities, Nanaka has been bravely confronting this daunting challenge.
Sacchin had brewed some black tea so we could all enjoy tea together once a cake was successfully produced, though it seems she jumped the gun a bit.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Hiyah!」
Nanaka snaps open her tightly clenched hand. Sitting in her palm, sure enough, is a single squished petit cake.

name: Sally
message: 「Yaho--! Chocolate cake. Don't mind if I do, again♪」

name: Synn
message: 「It really does end up losing its shape, doesn't it.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ugh... If it weren't for that, wouldn't you say I'm doing pretty well?」

name: Synn
message: 「Pretty well? You nailed it. Even if it's a little squished, it tastes the exact same, right?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's a total fail, I'm telling ya.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Haaah~, I want Synn to eat sweets that I pull out like a magic trick, just like Senpai's kashiwa mochi...」

name: Sacchin
message: 「I see~. So you wanna feed Synn-kun things other than soba too, huh~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Sa-Sa-Sa-Sacchin, what are you talking about!?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Uhihi, I'm totally onto you~? Nana-chan has a thing for Synn-kun~」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Waaah, waaaah, uwaaaah!!」

name: Synn
message: 「What about me?」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Well, you see~, huh? Nana-chan, you've got melted chocolate on your finger~?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh, you're right. I gotta go wash it off.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Leave it to me~. Aaah, nom... *slurp*, *lick, lick*」

name: Nanaka
message: 「G-Gyaaaaah~!? What the heck do you think you're doing, Sacchin!」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Mmm~. Seeing Nana-chan's dirty finger just made me want to clean it right up~」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Oh my~? Nana-chan, you've still got some chocolate left~? ...Mind if I?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「No way, no way, no waaay!!」

name: Synn
message: 「I have some tissues if you want them?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Too slow, Synn! Hand 'em over already!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Also, another thing... Between kashiwa mochi and a petit cake, isn't a petit cake bound to get squished way easier no matter what?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Now that you mention it... W-What a blunder!!」

name: Paqy
message: 「You should've realized that from the start.」

name: Sacchin
message: 「Ehehe~, love truly is blind, isn't it~」

name: Synn
message: 「Huh?」
That day, Nanaka tried hard three more times, yet all of the petit cakes ended up getting eaten by Sally-chan.
